assessment_summary:
Inspected the shared container at /workspace (commit e5a8336) and validated each component by running the guide's documented commands and querying local interfaces, favoring runtime behavior over file existence.

BACKEND (success component): Docker Compose services required by the guide are all up and healthy; the built Spring Boot jar runs under JDK 25; management health returns UP; Flyway migrations executed; Meilisearch indexes were created and 34 events imported; the REST API responds (Swagger UI 200, OpenAPI spec served, /v2/* reachable but auth-gated with 401). Gradle :menden-app:tasks returns BUILD SUCCESSFUL. A doc discrepancy exists (guide says JDK 21, toolchain requires JDK 25), but the installed config uses JDK 25 and functions, so it is not an install defect.

FRONTEND app/ and cms/ (failure component): The guide's own commands fail. `pnpm nx serve/build erlebnis.stadt` and `pnpm start` (cms) exit 1 with 'Could not find Nx modules ... Have you run npm/yarn install?'. The node_modules trees contain only an empty .pnpm directory — no .bin, no top-level symlinks, no .modules.yaml, no .pnpm/lock.yaml — and every required private @sw-code/urbo-* package (including the app's core dependency urbo-core and cms deps urbo-cms-*) is an empty placeholder with zero payload files. The root cause is authentic and matches the install summary: packages come from GitHub Packages, which returns 401 without a GITHUB_TOKEN, and no token exists in the environment; no public mirror was available. No frontend dev server listens on 4200/4300/4201 and no dist build output exists.

LIMITATIONS: Secondary details (e.g., exact API endpoint count) could not be enumerated, but they do not affect the verdict. The frontend failures reproduce deterministically from the documented commands, so they are not an environmental limitation of validation. Because the Erlebnis.Stadt platform per the project README comprises both the app frontend and the CMS in addition to the backend, the installation is incomplete and the frontend cannot operate without further installation work (GitHub PAT + pnpm install). Assessed as failure.
